home.modelsTitle: Nine business models for partner transformation
home.modelsBody: WeiBoYun’s rebate system helps service providers build their own go-to-market models — shifting from hardware sales to asset-light operations.

models.title: Free equipment placement
models.body: Rebates can cover equipment cost in 1–3 months, accelerating market capture in a healthy closed loop.

models.title: Duration coupon procurement
models.body: Providers invest in equipment and cash, co-purchasing parking-duration coupons with lots.

models.title: Flat-rate operations contract
models.body: Free equipment plus contracting operations rights at annual revenue pricing.

models.title: Berth swap model
models.body: Free equipment in exchange for a defined set of parking berth resources.

models.title: Incremental revenue share
models.body: Free equipment; excess incremental revenue is shared by agreed ratios.

models.title: Cloud hosting fee per lane
models.body: Free equipment with a fixed monthly cloud hosting fee charged per lane.

models.title: Fee-recovery revenue share
models.body: Free equipment; successful unpaid-fee recovery is shared with the lot.

models.title: After-sales maintenance fee
models.body: Free equipment with monthly or annual maintenance and after-sales fees.

models.title: Traditional hardware sales
models.body: Keep existing equipment sales while building pyramid and tree rebate architectures.

home.whoLead: Since entering internet parking in 2012, the team has invented many industry products and built fourteen years of smart-parking depth.

whoMilestones.title: Launched China’s first mobile internet parking platform
points: Founded Jinan Daxing Information Technology and launched China’s first mobile internet parking platform.
Delivered China’s first smart-parking voice order recognition and submission system — starting the mobile internet parking industry path.

whoMilestones.title: Built a unified parking brand and invented e-coupons
points: Launched China’s first electronic coupon platform service, replacing chaotic paper booth coupons.
By late 2014 the team moved to Beijing to build a unified domestic parking brand.

whoMilestones.title: Founded WeiBoYun pure-cloud architecture with auto O&M
points: China’s first flagship smart-parking cloud with auto wake/cleanup and fault-escape capability.
Launched mobile cloud booth, emergency charging, mobile cloud duty, linkage, and auto refund products.

whoMilestones.title: Vehicles online, AI enters, diversified monetization
points: Released a leading global payment-settlement AI hub, with IoV services, owner profiling, and entry/exit alerts for refined ops.
Launched nine business models and product lines such as monthly-card top-up and collection algorithms to upgrade the parking industry.

whoMilestones.title: AI global automated after-sales · free cloud seating
points: Order-level realtime analytics and vehicle trajectory services; AI and cloud algorithms automate 70% of after-sales.
Industry-first 7×24 vehicle-level cloud hosting and lot-level after-sales with minute response; space-level control for efficient bay use.
